content: Privacy-first analytics pattern (Plausible/Fathom/Umami style): hash IP+UserAgent+daily-rotating-salt with SHA-256 to derive an ephemeral unique-visitor id that cannot be linked across days or to a real person; no cookies, no persistent identifiers, no raw IP stored. Country resolved via local GeoIP-lite/MaxMind DB lookup on the raw IP at request time, then the raw IP is discarded (only country code persisted). This avoids GDPR consent-banner requirements since no personal data is retained.
